note: GFP state park in a wooded ravine 15 miles NW of Sisseton (near Veblen), known for fall color and 10 miles of multiuse horse, hike and bike trails. A two-part campground in a meadow: sites 1-4 by the entrance and 5-14 about 300 m further in. Most sites are equestrian sites with a corral. --Claude
